claims.quote: Thumbprint sign on lateral neck Acute epiglottitis (Hib historically; now mostly other org)

claims.text: Buzzword: thumbprint sign on lat neck XR → acute epiglottitis
claims.quote: Thumbprint sign Lateral neck X-ray Acute epiglottitis

claims.text: Aspects (abnorm in red) Neck radiograph: enlrg epiglottis (thumb sign) and distention of the hypopharynx
claims.quote: Enlarged epiglottis (thumb sign) and distention of the hypopharynx

claims.text: If sus, flexible fiberoptic laryngoscopy may be done in the operating room; reserve imaging for cases w very ↓sus
claims.quote: If the diagnosis is suspected, flexible fiberoptic laryngoscopy may be performed in the operating room; reserve imaging tests for cases with very low suspicion.

claims.text: Eti A rapidly progress bact infect of the epiglottis and surrounding tissues that may lead to sudden resp obstruct and death
claims.quote: Epiglottitis is a rapidly progressive bacterial infection of the epiglottis and surrounding tissues that may lead to sudden respiratory obstruction and death.

claims.text: Incidence has fallen significantly, particularly in children, w widespread vax against the MCC, H-flu type B
claims.quote: The incidence of epiglottitis has decreased significantly, particularly in children, because of widespread vaccination against the most common cause, Haemophilus influenzae type B.

claims.text: Now more freq in adults, particularly those w comorbidities
claims.quote: Epiglottitis is now more frequent in adults, particularly in those with comorbidities (eg, cardiovascular, respiratory, or other infectious diagnoses) (3).

claims.text: Sx Severe sore throat, dysphagia, ↑fever, drooling and inspir stridor
claims.quote: Symptoms include severe sore throat, dysphagia, high fever, drooling, and inspiratory stridor.

claims.text: Drooling w.o a barking cough = a hallmark characteristic, considered highly specific and sensitive
claims.quote: Drooling without a barking cough is a hallmark characteristic and is considered highly specific and sensitive for epiglottitis (1).

claims.text: Stridor, or sore throat w a normal-appearing pharynx, should raise sus
claims.quote: Stridor, as well as sore throat with a normal-appearing pharynx, should raise suspicion of epiglottitis.

claims.text: Tx and next step Her chart: airway control b4 any procedures; do ⍉examine w.o anesthesia/ENT
claims.quote: Airway control before any procedures; do NOT examine without anesthesia/ENT
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Pediatric / Congenital CXR Signs table

claims.text: In children w stridor and sus epiglottitis, examining the pharynx or larynx may precipitate complete airway obstruct; only specifically trained personnel should examine, in an operating room
claims.quote: In children with stridor and suspected epiglottitis, examination of the pharynx or larynx may precipitate complete airway obstruction; only specifically trained personnel should directly examine the pharynx and larynx, and the examination should be performed in an operating room.

claims.text: Children typically need the airway secured by trach intubation; adults w.o severe obstruct can often be monitored closely in an ICU
claims.quote: Children typically should have their airway secured by tracheal intubation; if airway obstruction is not severe, adults can often be monitored closely for signs of airway compromise in an intensive care unit.

claims.text: Give a beta-lactamase–resistant antibiotic, such as ceftriaxone
claims.quote: Administer a beta-lactamase–resistant antibiotic, such as ceftriaxone.
